root_cause.text: In the `ethosu_gem_cmdstream_copy_and_validate` function, the index increment performed when handling 64-bit commands is not validated against the buffer size limit before writing the second word, enabling a heap out-of-bounds write.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces a bounds check `if (i >= size / 4)` immediately after the explicit `i++` inside the `if (cmd & 0x4000)` block, preventing the write `bocmds[i] = cmds[1]` when the index has exceeded the valid range `[0, size/4-1]` defined by the DMA allocation.
